Financial Performance Report – FY 2025
and FY 2026
Company: Astravion Technologies
Reporting Currency: AED
Document Version: 1.0
1. Annual Financial Performance
All monetary amounts are expressed in AED millions.
Financial Particulars 	FY 2025 FY 2026
Revenue 	15.50 20.75
Cost of Revenue 	5.20 	7.10
Gross Profit 	10.30 13.65

Net Profit 	5.80 	8.40
Digital Infrastructure Recovery Benefits 0.45 	0.85
Intelligent Resource Optimization Savings 0.25 	0.60

Company: Nexovanta
Currency: USD

Reporting Period Revenue Net Profit Cloud Optimization
Savings

Astravion Technologies Capital Expenditure 	FY 2026 AED 	750,000
Nexovanta 	Operating Profit 	FY 2025 USD 	450,000
Velmora Energy Recovery
Benefits FY 2026 EUR 	325,250.75
Quantivex 	Net Profit 	FY 2025 INR 1,25,00,00
0
4. Financial Performance in Paragraphs
Meridian Technologies reported revenue of INR 15.5 crore and net profit of INR 2.5 crore for FY
2025. Its operating expenses amounted to INR 85 lakh.
Velmora recorded automated infrastructure efficiency gains of EUR 450,000 and sustainable
energy recovery savings of EUR 125,000 during FY 2026.
Quantivex reported revenue of AED 12 million in FY 2025 and AED 18 million in FY 2026.

5. Financial and Operational Ratios
Company: Nexovanta
Reporting Period: FY 2026
Currency for monetary amounts: USD
Indicator 	Value
Operating Loss 	(250,000)
Net Profit Margin 	18.5%

Total Employees 	135
Total Assets 8,500,00
0
Deferred Tax Adjustment N/A
6. Actual and Budget Performance
Company: Astravion Technologies
All monetary amounts are expressed in AED millions.
Financial Metric FY 2026 Actual FY 2026 Budget
Revenue 	20.75 	22.00
Net Profit 	8.40 	9.00

Operating
Expenses 5.25 	5.50
7. Additional Information
Astravion Technologies was established in 1998.
The report was approved on 25 November 2026 under reference number 45821.
Astravion Technologies reported administrative expenses of AED 2025 for FY 2026.
End of Report
